profile.headline: SECURE THE INFRASTRUCTURE
profile.about: Security and technology professional with verified operational leadership in Aviation Security, CCTV Surveillance Matrix, Biometric Access Control Systems, and Enterprise IP Networks. Experienced in managing security protocols across five-star international hotels, commercial complexes, and Tier-3 NOC environments.

points: Directed full-scope facility security operations, administration, and emergency safety protocols.
Supervised deployed security workforce, tactical post assignments, and standard operational procedures (SOPs).
Managed central CCTV control monitoring, biometric gate access, and visitor database integrity.
Led technical vendor collaborations for security hardware maintenance and network upgrades.
Spearheaded security infrastructure across luxury hotels, shopping malls, and convention centers.
Conducted comprehensive threat assessments, security audits, and risk minimization strategies.
Supervised maintenance contracts and performance benchmarks for surveillance systems.
Delivered responsive Tier-1/2 customer support with rapid first-contact resolution metrics.
Consulted on business security solutions and coordinated directly with enterprise clients (BRAC Bank).
Administered enterprise network backbones, sustaining 99.9% uptime across routing infrastructures.
Led a 7-engineer NOC team, reducing incident response latency by 50%.
Maintained core data center servers, firewalls, routing protocols, and disaster recovery architectures.
